correctness.rationale: For n>=3 the implicit sweep matrix has a strictly lower-triangular part; determinant expansion exhausts ring matchings and two directed cycles with weights z or 1. The cycle-matching trace polynomial is monomial exactly for power-of-two n. A strictly sub-half-degree monomial excludes unbalanced ascents, and Cayley-Hamilton gives all-state extinction. Circular Eulerian counting is bijective. Independent subset-determinant checks pass for all 5910 orders n=3..7 and 399 larger samples.
